composition_label: Guided setup -> Normal research -> Sentiment & prioritization -> Behavioral personalization

construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: Exactly schema_version=1, synthetic=true, guided, normal, sentiment, behavior. See example_input.json for the executable synthetic fixture.
shared_schema.validation: Validator handles input and stage contracts. Unknown/missing fields, invalid types, bool-as-int, duplicate identifiers, invalid timestamps and broken prerequisites are rejected. CLI rejects duplicate JSON keys and non-finite JSON constants.
shared_schema.output: schema_version, synthetic, status, stages. Each populated stage uses {schema_version, stage, data}. Incomplete onboarding yields status=blocked and null later stages. Errors yield {status:error,error:message}, exit 2.
shared_schema.citations: {source_id,start,end,quote}; Unicode character offsets, exclusive end, exactly sliced from original document
shared_schema.timestamps: ISO 8601 with timezone; events must be no later than explicit as_of

cross_stage_handoffs: guided -> normal: validated ready flag and query; research cannot run without all prerequisite steps
normal -> sentiment: ranked passages, exact citations, source severity and lexical relevance
sentiment -> behavior: validated scores, severity-aware priorities and citation text drive matching catalog tags

behavior.guided: Prefix-ordered profile, consent, research steps; email/name, accepted consent and nonempty tokenized query validation; completed steps, next step and fractional progress.
behavior.normal: Sentence-like passages split at ASCII .!? and newlines. Relevance is unique query-token coverage. Positive-overlap passages only, top_k, ties by source ID and start offset. Extractive findings are exact quotes, not generated summaries.
behavior.sentiment: Fixed English lexicon; immediately preceding not/never/no flips a contribution. Score=sum(values)/sum(abs(values)), or zero with no matches. All contributions exposed. Priority=severity base (10/20/30/40)+5*max(0,-score)+relevance. All retrieved findings are retained as scored issues, including neutral/positive observations, subject to max_issues.
behavior.behavior: History sums browse=1 or purchase=3 times 2^(-age_days/30). Each negative issue adds matched-tag-token fraction * priority/10. Positive/neutral observations do not boost issue scores. Total=history+issues. Scores rounded to six decimals, ties by item ID. Duplicate events count as separate observations.
behavior.cold_start: No events means cold_start=true; negative-issue matches rank first, otherwise deterministic ID ordering. No popularity or invented user history.
behavior.determinism: Explicit as_of clock, no randomness, stable tie breakers, input not mutated.

test_outcomes.cli_status: passed: one JSON object, status=ok, exit=0
test_outcomes.cli_error_behavior: Verified missing file, missing argument, malformed JSON, duplicate keys, non-finite constant, invalid schema: JSON status=error and exit=2
